A1.description: A full marketplace for local sellers: storefronts, cart, checkout and payouts in one flow. Built for low-end phones and slow networks first, then everything else.

A2.description: Hosting, publishing and analytics for independent podcasters. Uploads get trimmed, normalized and transcoded automatically before they go live.

A3.description: A command-line toolkit that scaffolds, seeds and deploys small web apps from a single config file. Ships with its own offline docs.

B1.description: An offline-first city guide with curated routes, local business pins and a bilingual interface. Works with zero bars of signal.

B2.description: A real-time 3D configurator and motion library used across our client sites. Everything runs in the browser — no plugins, no downloads.
